info.timeAllocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
info.description:
This course equips students with knowledge of the C++ programming language from basic to advanced,
*) Basics
- C++ Keywords, C++ Variable Types, Lvalues and Rvalues, Operators in C++, Strings, Arrrays, Pointerts, C++ References, C++ Basic Input/Output ...
- OOP
*) Advance:
C/C++ Standard Template Libaries, Files/streaming ,Exception, template, multithread, smartpointer, etc.
info.studentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.
- Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time.
- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose.
- Promptly access to the https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information.

materials.materialDescription: MOOC: Introduction to Object Oriented Programming (C++)
materials.author: Chris Szalwinski
Stanley B. Lippman, José Lajoie, Barbara E. Moo

clos.loDetails: Understand and apply fundamental concepts of C++ programming to develop basic computational solutions
Effectively manage memory and organize data using advanced C++ programming techniques
Write modular, reusable, and efficient C++ programs using advanced programming techniques and standard libraries.
Apply object-oriented programming principles and techniques in C++ to design robust, modular, and maintainable software solutions.
Apply advanced C++ programming features and file handling techniques to develop flexible and efficient software solutions.

sessions.topic: Introduction to C++ and Development Environment
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 1 - Introduction to C++ and Basic Syntax
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Write a “Hello, World!” program.
- Modify the program to print user-inputted text.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 1 - Introduction to C++ and Basic Syntax
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Debug and fix syntax errors in a provided C++ program.
- Use cout and cin for basic input/output operations.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 1 - Introduction to C++ and Basic Syntax
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Declare variables and perform basic arithmetic operations.
- Use constants to store fixed values.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 2 - Operators, Expressions, and Basic I/O
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Write a program to calculate the area of a rectangle.
- Implement logical expressions for simple decision-making.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 2 - Operators, Expressions, and Basic I/O
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Predict and fix unexpected results due to operator precedence.
- Implement explicit type conversion using static_cast<>.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 2 - Operators, Expressions, and Basic I/O
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Create a basic calculator using arithmetic operators.
- Read and print user information (name, age, and city).

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 3 - Control Structures - Decision Making and Loops
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Write a program to check if a number is even or odd.
- Implement a grading system using switch-case.

sessions.topic: Looping Constructs & Nested Loops and Logical Flow
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 3 - Control Structures – Decision Making and Loops
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Write a program to print the first N Fibonacci numbers.
- Implement a countdown timer using loops.
- Implement a simple multiplication table generator.
- Write a program to print a pyramid pattern using *.

sessions.studentMaterials: Lab's questions
Slides - Slot 4 - Arrays and Pointer Fundamentals
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Find the maximum and minimum values in an array.
- Reverse an array.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 4 - Arrays and Pointer Fundamentals
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Swap two numbers using pointers.
- Implement a function to reverse an array using pointers.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 4 - Arrays and Pointer Fundamentals
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a function that returns a pointer to the largest element in an array.
- Demonstrate pointer-based iteration through a two-dimensional array.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 5 - Dynamic Memory Allocation & Advanced Pointer Usage
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Create a dynamic array and fill it with user input.
- Implement a simple dynamic list with manual memory allocation.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 5 - Dynamic Memory Allocation & Advanced Pointer Usage
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Demonstrate a scenario where a memory leak occurs, then fix it.
- Implement a function that safely reallocates an array.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 5 - Dynamic Memory Allocation & Advanced Pointer Usage
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a dynamically allocated matrix and perform basic operations.
- Develop a simple memory-efficient data storage system.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 6 - Structs, Unions, and Complex Data Organization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Define a Student struct and store multiple students' information.
- Sort an array of structs based on GPA.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 6 - Structs, Unions, and Complex Data Organization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a union to store either an integer or a float in minimal memory.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 6 - Structs, Unions, and Complex Data Organization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Define a Library struct where each book has multiple authors.
- Write and read struct data from a file.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 7 - Memory Management and Performance Optimization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a program that dynamically allocates and deallocates memory efficiently.

sessions.topic:
Smart Pointers and RAII
Performance Optimization and Best Practices
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 7 - Memory Management and Performance Optimization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Convert a raw pointer-based program to use smart pointers.
- Analyze and optimize a sample C++ program for better memory efficiency.

sessions.studentMaterials: Lab's questions
Slides - Slot 8 - Functions, Overloading, and Template Programming
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a function to calculate the factorial of a number.
- Create a function to find the greatest common divisor (GCD) using recursion.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 8 - Functions, Overloading, and Template Programming
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement an overloaded function for calculating areas of different shapes.
- Use default parameters for flexible function behavior.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 8 - Functions, Overloading, and Template Programming
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a function template for finding the maximum of two values.
- Create a simple class template for handling an array of any data type.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 9 - Scope, Namespaces, and Visibility Rules
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Demonstrate variable scope using static and global variables.
- Implement a program that manages variables across multiple files.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 9 - Scope, Namespaces, and Visibility Rules
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a program using multiple namespaces for different modules.
- Use namespace to organize a library system.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 9 - Scope, Namespaces, and Visibility Rules
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement encapsulation in a C++ class with getter/setter functions.
- Control access to class members in a real-world scenario.

sessions.topic: Overview of Standard Library (STL) & Common Containers
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 10 - Introduction to STL Containers & Algorithms
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a dynamic list using std::vector.
- Store and retrieve key-value pairs using std::map.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 10 - Introduction to STL Containers & Algorithms
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Sort and search elements in a std::vector.
- Implement a simple contact management system using std::map.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 10 - Introduction to STL Containers & Algorithms
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a task manager using std::queue.
- Demonstrate stack-based undo functionality.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 11 - Introduction to STL Features & Optimization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Use lambda functions to apply transformations on a std::vector.
- Implement custom sorting criteria using lambdas.

sessions.topic:
STL Performance Considerations & Optimization.
Real-World STL Applications.
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 11 - Introduction to STL Features & Optimization
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Optimize an existing program by choosing the right STL container.
- Implement a high-performance data processing application using STL.
- Develop a student record system using map, vector, and STL algorithms.
- Implement a real-time event processing system using queue and priority_queue.

sessions.studentMaterials: Lab's questions
Slides - Slot 12 - Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & Encapsulation
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Define a Car class with attributes (brand, model, year).
- Create and manipulate objects from the class.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 12 - Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & Encapsulation
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement encapsulation in a BankAccount class with private balance.
- Use constructors to initialize object values.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 12 - Introduction to Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) & Encapsulation
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Create a Student class with static member to count students.
- Implement a method to update object attributes dynamically.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 13 - Inheritance - Code Reusability & Hierarchical Design
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Create a Person class and inherit Student and Teacher from it.
- Demonstrate different access levels in inheritance.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 13 - Inheritance - Code Reusability & Hierarchical Design
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement multi-level inheritance (Animal → Mammal → Dog).
- Use constructor chaining to initialize derived class attributes.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 13 - Inheritance - Code Reusability & Hierarchical Design
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Create a Shape class with draw() method and override it in Circle and Rectangle.
- Implement runtime polymorphism using pointers to base class.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 14 - Polymorphism & Special Member Functions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Overload + operator to add two Complex numbers.
- Implement << and >> operators for easy input/output.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 14 - Polymorphism & Special Member Functions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Demonstrate object copying with copy constructor.
- Optimize memory using move constructor.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 14 - Polymorphism & Special Member Functions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Demonstrate object destruction in polymorphic class hierarchy.
- Convert raw pointer-based code to use unique_ptr.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 15 - Exception Handling & Robust Application Design
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement division by zero exception handling.
- Handle invalid user input in a number conversion program.

sessions.topic: Handling Multiple Exceptions & Custom Exceptions, Exception Safety
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 15 - Exception Handling & Robust Application Design
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement exception handling for array index out of bounds.
- Create a BankTransaction class with a custom exception for insufficient balance.
- Use RAII for managing dynamic memory safely.

sessions.studentMaterials: Lab's questions

sessions.topic: Introduction to File I/O & Text File Handling
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 16 - Text File Handling & Basic File Operations
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Write a program to store and retrieve student records from a text file.
- Implement a simple logging system that appends messages to a file.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 16 - Text File Handling & Basic File Operations
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Develop a contact book where users can add and search contacts.
- Implement a CSV parser to read structured text data.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 16 - Text File Handling & Basic File Operations
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Optimize file reading operations for better efficiency.
- Identify and fix common file handling errors in sample code.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 17 - Binary File Handling & File Processing
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a program to store and retrieve employee records in binary format.
- Demonstrate random access file operations (seekg, seekp, tellg, tellp).

sessions.topic: File Processing – Searching, Updating, and Deleting
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 17 - Binary File Handling & File Processing
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a basic student management system that allows adding, updating, and deleting records.
- Create a binary-based inventory system that maintains product details.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 17 - Binary File Handling & File Processing
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement a file-based caching system to reduce read/write overhead.
- Optimize an existing file handling program for better performance.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 18 - Preprocessor Directives & Type Conversions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement header guards to prevent multiple inclusions.
- Use #define macros for constant expressions and debugging.

sessions.topic: Type Casting and Type Conversion Operators
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 18 - Preprocessor Directives & Type Conversions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement custom type conversion for a Temperature class (Celsius ↔ Fahrenheit).
- Use dynamic_cast for safe downcasting in an OOP hierarchy.

sessions.topic: Best Practices for Type Safety & Optimization
sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 18 - Preprocessor Directives & Type Conversions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Optimize memory usage by choosing appropriate data types for calculations.
- Debug a program with incorrect type conversions and apply correct casting.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 19 - Smart Pointers, Multithreading, and Lambda Expressions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Convert raw pointer-based memory management to smart pointers.
- Demonstrate circular reference issues and solve them using weak_ptr.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 19 - Smart Pointers, Multithreading, and Lambda Expressions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Implement multithreading to execute multiple tasks in parallel.
- Use mutex to prevent race conditions in shared data.

sessions.studentMaterials: Slides - Slot 19 - Smart Pointers, Multithreading, and Lambda Expressions
sessions.studentTasks:
Hands-on exercises:
- Use lambda functions for dynamic sorting and filtering.
- Implement a callback mechanism using function pointers and lambdas.
